maddeler.e:
تحترفوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِفُوا (taḥtarifū) /taħ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# تُحْتَرَفُوا (tuḥtarafū) /tuħ.ta.ra.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
